0022600204.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (5-5, 7th in the East, coming off a loss) visit the Charlotte Hornets (3-7, 10th in the East, on a six-game losing streak) in the Cavaliers' 11th game of the 2026-27 season. Cleveland is without Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), while Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
